FIELDS.NAME: Crafty Corner Supplies
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Crafty Corner Supplies, we specialize in providing a wide range of high-quality craft and hobby materials to our customers. Our operations include retail sales of supplies related to scrapbooking, painting, knitting, model building, and other creative projects. We engage in a well-organized inventory management system, ensuring that products are efficiently stocked and easily accessible. 

Our store is designed to create a welcoming atmosphere, featuring clear aisles and proper lighting to enhance the shopping experience and minimize any safety risks. We also conduct regular safety inspections to comply with all local fire and safety codes, ensuring a secure environment for our customers and employees.

In addition to retail, we offer instructional classes and workshops aimed at enriching our community's craft skills. These classes are covered by appropriate professional liability insurance to safeguard against any potential claims arising from our instructional activities. We diligently maintain a clean safety record with no recent claims related to customer or employee injuries, reflecting our commitment to safety and effective risk management.

Crafty Corner Supplies is also dedicated to customer engagement, participating in community events and offering resources to help foster a creative environment. We take pride in ensuring that all products in our store meet safety standards, promoting a responsible business practice that customers can trust.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/12/2023, a minor water leak occurred in the store due to a faulty ceiling pipe, resulting in damage to inventory. The estimated loss amounted to $2,500. The incident has been resolved with repairs made and no further issues reported, thus, the status is closed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: 100% central station monitored alarm system with designated watchpersons during store hours.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Crafty Corner Supplies does not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. Our operations primarily focus on retailing craft supplies, which do not include hazardous materials exceeding minimal, consumer-safe quantities.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – We sponsor local athletic teams as part of our community engagement efforts, promoting creativity and sportsmanship among youth.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The store manager, Jessica Taylor, is responsible for checking the certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions for fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property for any applicant.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Crafty Corner Supplies has not declined, canceled, or non-renewed any policy or coverage in the prior three years. We maintain a consistent insurance history and compliance with all relevant insurance requirements.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Crafty Corner Supplies does not lease employees to or from other employers. All employees are directly hired and managed by the company.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Crafty Corner Supplies carries Workers' Compensation insurance, ensuring compliance with legal requirements for employee coverage. This policy is actively maintained and protects both the business and its employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Crafty Corner Supplies does not own or operate any other business. Our focus remains solely on providing a wide range of craft and hobby materials to our customers.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Crafty Corner Supplies does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. We currently maintain one active policy for our operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Crafty Corner Supplies is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on retail sales of craft and hobby materials.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Crafty Corner Supplies does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our focus is primarily on retailing craft supplies without engaging in equipment rentals.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Crafty Corner Supplies has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years, maintaining financial stability during this period.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Crafty Corner Supplies does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals beyond minimal consumer-safe quantities as we focus solely on retailing craft supplies. Our operations prioritize safety and compliance with all relevant regulations.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Crafty Corner Supplies does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are focused on retail sales of craft supplies without engaging in activities that typically present such risks. We maintain a secure environment and comply with all safety regulations to mitigate potential hazards.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Crafty Corner Supplies has not experienced any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We maintain a strong commitment to ethical practices and employee training, ensuring a safe environment for all.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Crafty Corner Supplies has no uncorrected fire code violations and conducts regular inspections to ensure compliance with all local fire and safety codes.
